title: Library multi-select: saved-recipe summary and native text sharing
summary: Screen 1 source slice: Select/Cancel, stable IDs, saved-servings/unknown-time summary and native text ShareLink. Grid hides discovery during selection. Default ON with OFF fallback. Batch delete, collection persistence and Meal Plan deferred. Six UI journeys join the existing native advisory selection; native compile, tests, Journal, pixels and device acceptance remain UNRUN.
